entries.description: PTP IEEE 1588 for Linux. Provides various tools, e.g. ptp4l and phc2sys.

entries.name: PAM
entries.description: FOSS AES67 capable audio monitor.

entries.name: Snapcast
entries.description: FOSS project for a Sonos-like multiroom solution, using a custom TCP-based protocol.

entries.name: Ravennakit SDK
entries.description: Provides a cross-platform C++ SDK for professional networked audio using AES67, RAVENNA, and ST2110-30.

entries.description: Open source implementation of Dante AoIP in Rust (GitHub mirror).

entries.name: ROC-streaming
entries.description: A tool for streaming audio over IP networks using UDP or RTP, specialized for real-time streaming. You write the stream to one end and read it from another end. Roc handles all the complexities.

entries.name: Aneman
entries.description: Audio NEtwork MANager, the Ravenna equivalent for Dante controller.

entries.name: PTP Track Hound
entries.description: PTP network traffic analysis tool (cross-platform, basic free version available).

entries.name: IPMX
entries.description: A proposed set of open standards and specifications for control, copy protection, connection management and security.

entries.name: Audinate
entries.description: Its proprietary Dante technology is the most popular AoIP solution by far.

entries.name: Ravenna
entries.description: Second most popular AoIP solution, which is more open than Dante.

entries.name: Networked Audio Products
entries.description: A census of AoIP products, conducted every year (current: 2025).

entries.name: Dante Certification
entries.description: Understanding Dante helps to understand AoIP. The training requires an account. I recommend lv 1 and lv 2.

entries.name: Ravenna Resources
entries.description: Webinars and slides by Andreas Hildebrand about Ravenna, AES67, SMPTE 2110, PTP and IPMX.

entries.description: Setting up AES67 to and from a Dante devices. This guide by Yamaha contains intricacies missing in Audinate docs.

entries.description: , public version - AES67 based audio transport in a video stream. Adds some contains to AES67.
